title: Cod pie with carrot and potato mash

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Every ingredient is plain home food: potatoes, carrots, leeks, cod, milk, butter, cornflour, cheddar and frozen peas.

supermarket.reason: All items are standard Tesco lines, and 600g cod fillet for four is a normal family purchase.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only two pans, a masher, a whisk and a baking dish, with simple boiling, softening and baking.

works.reason: Quantities suit four, 3 tbsp cornflour will thicken 500ml milk enough to hold the cod's juices, and the raw cod chunks will cook through in 30 minutes at 200°C.

honest_times.reason: Thirty minutes of active work covers peeling and chopping, mashing, the 10-minute leek soften and the sauce, and the 45 minutes of cook time matches 15 minutes boiling plus 30 baking.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, names match their ids, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warming fish pie suits 23 December, and the 500g of carrots runs through both the mash and the filling, as the title promises.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are brief, plain British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a proper family dinner of fish, vegetables and potato with modest butter and cheese.
